messages:
Maya: Quick sync — are we green on the GA readiness checklist for SLAs, docs, support rotations, monitoring, and pricing? Need a short go/no-go summary by EOD.
Sam: Mostly green. Docs + pricing need final sign-off. SLA text is drafted.
Diego: Monitoring dashboards done, alerting playbooks in draft. I'll push last graf by noon.
Jordan: Support rotation plan updated. Still need confirmation on oncall headcount from Eng-SRE.
Lucy: Billing/pricing: tier names and per-token bands are set, but we need approval on burst thresholds for pilot customers.
Maya: Ping @Sam @Lucy — can you paste SLA draft here so legal & sales can eyeball?
Sam: Sure — quick excerpt:
```
SLA: 99.9% platform availability measured monthly. Credits apply when downtime > 60m/mo. Exclusions: scheduled maintenance, force majeure, customer misconfiguration.
Support: Standard (email 48h), Priority (chat 4h), Enterprise (1h + phone).
```
Diego: That looks reasonable. Suggest adding explicit fallback behavior when a model variant is unavailable (route to compatible variant + telemetry event).
Jordan: Agreed. Also add escalation for failed canary rollouts: auto-rollback + notify oncall.
Lucy: For billing: propose burst buffer where pilot tenants get 5% over quota for 24h before throttling. Need sales to confirm commercial appetite.
Maya: Sales has one enterprise pilot asking for 20% burst. Can we make burst configurable per-customer in Dedicated?
Diego: Technically yes. Need policy in the Console UI + RBAC guardrails. Not a blocker for GA, but note as post-GA config work.
Sam: Legal asked to soften the credit language — replace "credits apply" with "service credits may be issued" and cap at X% of monthly invoice.
Maya: Can we get a suggested cap?
Lucy: Finance suggests capping at 30% for the first 3 months of GA, revisit after initial telemetry.
Jordan: Oncall: Eng-SRE will provide headcount by EOD. Ops-bot, reminder to run rota simulation?
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: /rota-sim --team eng-sre --start 2026-05-04 --duration 30d. Simulation complete: minimal overlap gaps found (2 small windows).
Maya: Excellent. Final checklist for owners: SLA wording (Sam + Legal), Docs (Diego + Docs team), Monitoring/alerts (Diego), Oncall headcount & rota (Jordan + Eng-SRE), Pricing burst policy (Lucy + Sales), Console RBAC for burst (Diego). Can we commit to ship GA with these as must-haves + list of post-GA improvements?
Sam: Yes, if Legal OKs softened credit language.
Diego: Monitoring and rollback behavior will be in initial GA runbook.
Lucy: I'll get Sales confirmation on burst tiers and note commercial exceptions.
Jordan: I'll sign off once Eng-SRE confirms headcount and handover plan.
Maya: Great. Action owners, please put final sign-off comment in this thread by 17:00 PT. If all signs are in, we'll trigger the release gate at 18:00 PT. :thumbsup:
Sam: Will do.
Diego: On it.
Lucy: Adding note to pricing doc now.
Jordan: Rota pinged Eng-SRE.
ops-bot: Deploy-checklist reminder: run smoke tests, canary for 2h, verify dashboards — scheduled for 18:30 PT.
Maya: Thanks team — keeping this thread as single source for sign-offs.
